item.title: New logo for 'NSM'; OSC-based audio session manager API, reference GUI app
item.dc:creator: New Session Manager
item.description: New Session Manager is a new community-led fork of NSM, the de facto libre audio session manager API in the JACK and audio production world. The fork brings a slightly better defined API, a new reference server and front-end GUI control app.
item.content:encoded:
Organization: New Session Manager

Status: closed

Compensation: gratis

Role: Logo design/branding

New Session Manager is a new community-led fork of NSM, the de facto libre audio session manager API in the JACK and audio production world. The fork brings a slightly better defined API, a new reference server and front-end GUI control app.

How to Apply:

  • Drop into the #lad channel on freenode IRC server and mention this request. Many interested parties will see the message there within 48 hours. Original issue: https://github.com/linuxaudio/new-session-manager/issues/52
  • <nil>
